notes.title: Abnormality Development Update
notes.notes:
[h1]Hi, Steam Community![/h1]

We know it's been quiet here for the past couple of months, and we sincerely apologize for any inconvenience this may have caused.

If you've been following our Discord, you're probably already aware that we encountered several issues after upgrading our studio equipment, including some project corruption.

However, we managed to get things back on track a couple of weeks ago, and I've been actively redeveloping all core systems from scratch. This redevelopment aims to provide a smoother experience, guided by the feedback and reviews we've received from all of you.

[b]We're excited to announce that a major update will be released in just a few days, and we hope you're as eager as we are![/b]

In the meantime, you can join our new Discord server:
[url=https://discord.gg/nightmarestudios]https://discord.gg/nightmarestudios[/url]

Cheers,
Nightmare Studios

notes.title: Demo Release
notes.notes:
We are proud to announce the demo for our new game, Abnormality is officially live! This is a good opportunity for you to see how the gameplay is ahead of the early access launch. Please feel free to leave feedback, we will be taking it all on board!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3176020/Abnormality_Demo/
